name: Vermont
agency: Vermont State Police, Department of Public Safety

rule.textEn: Anyone 12 or older born after Jan. 1, 1974 needs a boating safety certificate to operate any motorboat, including a PWC.
rule.textEs: Toda persona de 12 años o más nacida después del 1 de enero de 1974 necesita un certificado de seguridad náutica para manejar cualquier embarcación a motor, incluida una moto acuática.

exemptions: Holders of a U.S. Coast Guard license to operate vessels commercially.
Motorboats on a body of water on private property.

card.feeNote: Study materials for the equivalency exam are free from Public Safety on request.

nonResident: Any NASBLA-approved certificate from another state or country is accepted.

sources.quote: An individual born after January 1, 1974 shall not operate a motorboat on the public waters of this State without first obtaining a certificate of boating education.

sources.publisher: Vermont State Police (Department of Public Safety)
sources.quote: Boating safety education is required for any motor boat operator (12 years of age or older) born after January 1, 1974.
an individual operating a motorboat on a body of water located on private property;
an individual who is licensed by the U.S. Coast Guard to operate a vessel for commercial purposes;
Once issued, the certificate of boating safety education is valid for the lifetime of the individual to whom it was issued
The Department of Public Safety shall replace, without charge, a lost or destroyed certificate

A boating safety certificate issued in another state or country in accordance with or substantially equivalent to criteria of the National Association of State Boating Law Administrators is sufficient

sources.publisher: Vermont State Police (Department of Public Safety)
sources.quote: The Boat Vermont internet course  is available online for those Vermont residents unable to attend a classroom course.
Upon request, the Department of Public Safety shall provide, without charge, boating safety education materials to individuals who plan to take the boating safety equivalency examination.
